text:
```artifact
states:
  - IDLE
  - STARTING
  - RUNNING
  - SHUTDOWN
  - SELFTESTING
  - CONFIGURING
  - RECONFIGURING
  - STATUS_REPORTING
  - ERROR_STATE

transitions:
  - from: IDLE
    on: START
    to: STARTING
  - from: STARTING
    on: ACK
    to: RUNNING
  - from: RUNNING
    on: SHUTDOWN
    to: SHUTDOWN
  - from: SHUTDOWN
    on: ACK
    to: IDLE
  - from: RUNNING
    on: SELFTEST
    to: SELFTESTING
  - from: SELFTESTING
    on: ACK
    to: RUNNING
  - from: RUNNING
    on: CONFIGURE
    to: CONFIGURING
  - from: CONFIGURING
    on: ACK
    to: RUNNING
  - from: RUNNING
    on: RECONFIGURE
    to: RECONFIGURING
  - from: RECONFIGURING
    on: ACK
    to: RUNNING
  - from: RUNNING
    on: STATUS_REQUEST
    to: STATUS_REPORTING
  - from: STATUS_REPORTING
    on: ACK
    to: RUNNING
  - from: ANY
    on: INVALID
    to: ERROR_STATE
```
